text: Opened the sealed box of ANC Pro Wireless Headphones and the USB-C braided charging cable was completely missing. Had to buy a cable separately.
author: Marcus Vance

text: The multi-point Bluetooth pairing manual is horribly written. It took 45 minutes of trial and error to get the speaker to connect to my laptop. Please include a clear setup diagram.
author: Sarah Jenkins

text: Box arrived dented and partially crushed because it was shipped in an ordinary plastic mailer bag with zero bubble wrap protection. Thankfully the device still works, but unacceptable packaging.
author: Alexander Schmidt

text: Ordered the Italian smart plug 3-pack, but the package contained UK 3-pin plugs without European adapters. Now I have to return the entire order.
author: Luca Benetti

text: Noise cancellation is great, but missing accessories inside a sealed retail unit suggests zero quality control at the assembly facility.
author: David Miller

text: Pairing with iOS devices is seamless, but Android instructions are outdated and refer to menu buttons that do not exist in the current firmware.
author: Elena Neri

text: Fragile electronics shipped with inadequate protective cushioning. Outer gift box was ripped open upon delivery.
author: Thomas Weber

text: Ordered two smart home hubs and neither included the quick-start guide or wall mounting screws listed on the packaging.
author: Claire Dupont

text: Customer service chat bot was unhelpful when reporting the missing power brick. Had to wait 4 business days for a human agent response.
author: Robert Taylor
